sam_sales: Hey team — prospect (FinSysX) asked for a quick POC plan: they want mixed convo + embedding traffic, sustained 120 qps with 1k concurrent users, plus 2x burst to 500 qps for 3m. Need latency targets p95 < 250ms and pricing for both hosted burst and a 3mo reserved commit. Also they attached a security questionnaire (KMS/HSM + logs). Can ops/eng propose a short runbook and rough cost delta?
jlee_eng: OK. Plan: three phases — baseline latency (single-zone, no cache), steady-state throughput (120 qps, 30m), and burst soak (simulate spikes to 500 qps for 3m). We'll test model variant rwd-3b-int8 and a smaller rwd-770m.
mika_sre: Sounds good. Notes: use 2x H100 equivalents (dedicated) for steady-state to avoid queueing jitter. Warm KV cache before steady-state with a 10m ramp at 30 qps. For burst, validate autoscaler cooldowns and fallback model variant.
 jlee_eng: Load commands I used locally:
```bash
# fortio for steady qps
fortio load -qps 120 -t 30m -c 200 http://ingress-test.example/api/generate -payload payload.json
# wrk2 for burst profile
wrk -t8 -c500 -d3m -R500 -s burst.lua http://ingress-test.example/api/generate
```
Please use same payload shape (avg prompt tokens ~120)
kate_cs: On the security side: FinSysX flagged encryption at rest + BYOK/HSM, audit logs retention 1yr, and SOC2 cert mention. I can answer questionnaire bits but need confirmation: hosted logs have 90d by default, can we offer enterprise retention add-on? Also can we confirm KMS integration (customer key) in Private?
mika_sre: Yes: Private/VPC supports BYOK via KMS and HSM integrations, and we can enable extended log retention as an add-on. Will surface config options in the POC doc.
jlee_eng: Results from a quick internal run on rwd-770m (dev cluster, not prod): baseline p50 38ms p95 112ms p99 270ms @ 60 qps single instance. With 2x H100-equivalent nodes and batching=8, steady 120 qps => p50 55ms p95 180ms p99 340ms. Burst to 500 qps (no extra capacity) produced queueing and p95 jumped to ~1.1s. Notes: enabling prefix KV cache reduced p95 by ~35% in steady state.
deploy-bot: automated-smoke: load test upload complete — artefacts at https://artifacts.internal/redwood/poc/finsysx/3376543210/ (contains full histograms + grafana links) :white_check_mark:
sam_sales: Great — can you add a short cost sketch? ballpark hosted per-token + burst surcharge vs 3mo reserved capacity cost estimate. Also include the doc snippet for customer-facing runbook.
jlee_eng: Ballpark: hosted: steady 120 qps (mixed prompts ~120 tokens req + 300 tokens resp) ~ ~2.4M tokens/day => hosted cost ~ $X/day (we'll fill precise numbers) + burst surcharge (we price bursts at 1.5x for instant capacity). Reserved 3mo (2x H100 equiv) reduces unit cost ~30% vs hosted. I'll prep a one-pager.
mika_sre: Operational blockers to call out: cold-start tail latency at first 10k requests (warmup recommended), multi-tenant noisy neighbor if hosted shared infra used — recommend Dedicated or Private for SLAs. Also confirm KMS attestation timeline with security team (couple days).
kate_cs: I'll coordinate answers to the questionnaire and confirm retention pricing. Sam — want me to join the call with FinSysX tomorrow?
sam_sales: Yes please, 10am PST. Add a short runbook section and pricing delta before then. thx! :thumbsup:
